cases.source: Separately authored synthetic fixture, 2026-10-29, after project documentation that recorded a divergence between two paths as plain behavior.
cases.rationale: Document a known defect as a defect with its item and its workaround as temporary.
In review, report a page that presents a known defect and its stopgap as normal behavior and practice.
A limitation with a recorded decision stays an intended limitation.
Behavior with no recorded intent is described as it is, without a reason or a defect label.
